name: Leonardo Da Vinci
original_name: レオナルド・ダ・ヴィンチ
source:
Leonardo is a genius, regarded by historians and scholars as the quintessential "Renaissance Man". He usually spends his days sating his curiosity by investigating anything that catches his eye. 
A bit of a lone wolf, he appears to be hiding a deep secret... 

"You're a unique one. You'd make a fascinating study-- for my research."
